# Import checklist

**3 folders · 21 markups · 3 imports**

Before you start:
- onX **Premium or Elite** is required to import.
- Use the **Web Map** at webmap.onxmaps.com on a computer.
- Each numbered step is ONE import. Drag in **all** the files for that step together.

### 1. 3 - Course Segments Dark Divide 100 Miler  (11 markups)

- [ ] My Content → **Import** → select **3_Course_Segments_Dark_Divide_100_Miler_Tracks.gpx**
- [ ] Tick **“Import map data to a new folder”**
- [ ] Click **Import**
- [ ] The new folder appears at the top named `Import <today>`. **Rename it to:** `3 - Course Segments Dark Divide 100 Miler`

### 2. 2 - Aid Stations Dark Divide 100 Miler  (9 markups)

- [ ] My Content → **Import** → select **2_Aid_Stations_Dark_Divide_100_Miler_Waypoints.gpx**
- [ ] Tick **“Import map data to a new folder”**
- [ ] Click **Import**
- [ ] The new folder appears at the top named `Import <today>`. **Rename it to:** `2 - Aid Stations Dark Divide 100 Miler`

### 3. 1 - Course GPX Dark Divide 100 Miler  (1 markups)

- [ ] My Content → **Import** → select **1_Course_GPX_Dark_Divide_100_Miler_Tracks.gpx**
- [ ] Tick **“Import map data to a new folder”**
- [ ] Click **Import**
- [ ] The new folder appears at the top named `Import <today>`. **Rename it to:** `1 - Course GPX Dark Divide 100 Miler`

### Notes longer than onX keeps on import (512 bytes)

onX keeps the first 512 bytes of an imported note -- about 512 characters of plain English; accented letters, dashes and emoji take 2-4 bytes each. Shorten these, or paste the rest into onX after import. (One earlier 3,000+ character note from an onX export was dropped outright, for a reason we have not found.)

- `[r2i1] 02 - Juniper Ridge AS (Used Twice)`: 617 bytes  (2 - Aid Stations Dark Divide 100 Miler)

---

When finished, My Content should show **3 folders** and **21 markups**.

If a folder is missing items, delete that folder and redo just its step.
